title: Specialisations of the Burungale-Castella-Skinner main conjecture to $\mathbb Z_p$-lines
summary: Let $p>3$ be a prime, $E/\mathbb Q$ be an elliptic curve and $K$ an imaginary quadratic field satisfying the hypotheses of Burungale-Castella-Skinner, and let $L/K$ be the unique $\mathbb{Z}_p^2$-extension. In this note, by combining their integral two-variable main conjecture with the specialisation formula of the first-named author, we obtain a characteristic-ideal identity over every $\mathbb{Z}_p$-line in $L/K$, involving an explicit local factor.
